title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 3 Great Consensuses

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the order and beauty in creation show about the One behind it?
questions.answer: It shows that He wants His perfect power and skill to be seen.

questions.question: Besides showing His power, what does the passage say He wants people to do toward Him?
questions.answer: He wants people to know Him and love Him.

questions.question: How does the passage say people are moved to praise and thank Him?
questions.answer: By the many blessings and enjoyable gifts He gives them.

questions.question: What response does the passage say people should have when they see how life is cared for and provided for?
questions.answer: They should worship with thankfulness and appreciation.

questions.question: Which regular changes in the world are mentioned as signs of His Lordship and Divinity?
questions.answer: The changing seasons and the coming of day and night.

questions.question: What attitudes toward God are meant to grow in people when they notice His mighty actions?
questions.answer: Faith, submission, humility, and obedience.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way divine justice appears in the world?
questions.answer: Goodness and good people are protected, while evil and wrongdoers are brought down.

questions.question: What two kinds of bad people are especially named as being struck by divine punishment?
questions.answer: Oppressors and liars.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of person would surely be close to this unseen Lord?
questions.answer: His most beloved servant and most devoted worshipper.

questions.question: What does that special servant do with the mystery of the universe?
questions.answer: He explains it and helps uncover its meaning.

questions.question: In whose name does that servant act?
questions.answer: He acts in the name of the Creator.

questions.question: From whom does that servant seek help and success?
questions.answer: From God.

questions.question: Who is identified in the passage as that beloved servant?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: After hearing the nine truths, what conclusion does the traveler reach about the Prophet’s place among people?
questions.answer: He concludes that the Prophet is the greatest source of honor and dignity for humanity.

questions.question: What two things are mentioned together as proof of the Prophet’s importance in the world?
questions.answer: The wide influence of the Qur’an and his own noble qualities.

questions.question: What does the passage say is the most important statement about the Creator?
questions.answer: The message spoken by the Prophet.

questions.question: What was the main purpose of the Prophet’s call and life?
questions.answer: To prove and declare God’s existence, oneness, attributes, and names.

questions.question: What gave strength to the Prophet’s mission, according to the passage?
questions.answer: His many clear miracles and the deep truths in his religion.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show the Prophet’s role in the universe?
questions.answer: He is compared to the sun as a bright proof of the Creator.

questions.question: What title does the passage give him to show his nearness to God?
questions.answer: The Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: How many kinds of strong agreement are mentioned to support his witness?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: Who makes up the first group of agreement?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family, including great saints and spiritually gifted people.

questions.question: What is special about the people in the first group?
questions.answer: They are known for deep spiritual insight and strong certainty.

questions.question: Who makes up the second group of agreement?
questions.answer: The Companions of the Prophet.

questions.question: What shows the strength of the Companions’ faith?
questions.answer: They were ready to give up their lives, wealth, and family ties for the truth.

questions.question: What kind of society did the Companions begin in?
questions.answer: A simple and unlettered society with little developed social or political structure.

questions.question: What major change happened to the Companions in a short time?
questions.answer: They became leaders, guides, and just rulers over advanced nations.

questions.question: Who makes up the third group of agreement?
questions.answer: Great scholars in every age who are careful, deep-thinking, and strong in many fields of knowledge.

questions.question: Why does the passage say the Prophet’s testimony cannot be shaken?
questions.answer: Because it is supported by broad, united, and certain agreement, not just by one person’s claim.

questions.question: What does the passage say even all demons together could not do?
questions.answer: They could not defeat or overturn this testimony.

questions.question: Whose final judgment is being reported at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The traveler’s.

questions.question: What does the passage say the unseen Creator wants to display through the world’s carefully made things?
questions.answer: His flawless skill and artistry.

questions.question: Through the many beautiful created things, what does He want from people?
questions.answer: He wants them to recognize Him and love Him.

questions.question: What effect are His many gifts meant to bring out from people?
questions.answer: Praise and gratitude.

questions.question: How should people answer His care and provision for living things?
questions.answer: With thankful worship.

questions.question: Which repeating patterns in nature are used as examples of His rule?
questions.answer: The cycle of the seasons and the turning of night and day.

questions.question: What does the passage say people should come to believe because of these signs?
questions.answer: His Divinity.

questions.question: Once people believe, what three character qualities should they show toward God?
questions.answer: Humility, submission, and obedience.

questions.question: How is God’s justice shown in His treatment of moral good and moral evil?
questions.answer: He supports what is right and destroys wrongdoing.

questions.question: What happens to tyrants and dishonest people in the passage’s description of justice?
questions.answer: They are struck down by heavenly punishment.

questions.question: Why does the passage say there must be a beloved servant near this unseen Lord?
questions.answer: Because the divine purposes in creation call for a servant who carries them out among people.

questions.question: What does that servant do with the puzzle of why the universe was created?
questions.answer: He discovers its meaning and explains it.

questions.question: How does the passage describe that servant’s relationship with God in his work?
questions.answer: He works for God, asks Him for help, and receives success from Him.

questions.question: Which person is named as fulfilling this role?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the traveler say these nine truths prove about the Prophet’s truthfulness and rank?
questions.answer: They prove that he is truly honored above mankind and the world.

questions.question: What world-changing result of the Qur’an is mentioned as a sign of the Prophet’s importance?
questions.answer: Its command and message spread over half the world.

questions.question: What personal side of the Prophet is also given as proof of his greatness?
questions.answer: His outstanding virtues and excellent character.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the most important message anyone can give about God?
questions.answer: The message delivered by the Prophet.

questions.question: What central truth stood at the heart of the Prophet’s whole mission?
questions.answer: Calling people to God’s existence and absolute oneness.

questions.question: What else did he affirm about God besides His existence and unity?
questions.answer: His attributes and names.

questions.question: What two supports for the Prophet’s mission are mentioned together?
questions.answer: Clear miracles and the powerful truths of his religion.

questions.question: What image is used to show how clearly the Prophet points to the Creator?
questions.answer: The image of the sun.

questions.question: What title in the passage shows his special closeness to Allah?
questions.answer: The Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: How many united bodies of testimony support what he says?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What is the first body of testimony?
questions.answer: The united witness of the Prophet’s family and the great saints among them.

questions.question: Which two famous figures are named from that first group?
questions.answer: Imam Ali and Abd al-Qadir al-Gilani.

questions.question: What is the second body of testimony?
questions.answer: The confirming witness of the Companions.

questions.question: What sacrifices prove the sincerity of the Companions?
questions.answer: They gave up wealth, safety, family connections, and even their lives.

questions.question: What makes the Companions’ change so remarkable?
questions.answer: They rose from a simple and unlearned setting to lead major civilizations justly.

questions.question: What is the third body of testimony?
questions.answer: The unanimous confirmation of profound scholars in every age.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s witness described as universal rather than personal only?
questions.answer: Because many groups across time and rank agree with it.

questions.question: What strong ending statement does the passage make about opposing this witness?
questions.answer: Not even all demons united could overcome it.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Creator wants to make known through the world’s fine workmanship?
questions.answer: The greatness and perfection of His art.

questions.question: What feeling toward the Creator is creation meant to awaken along with recognition?
questions.answer: Love.

questions.question: What part do blessings play in human response to God?
questions.answer: They lead people to praise Him and thank Him.

questions.question: What does the passage connect with worship that is full of gratitude?
questions.answer: God’s caring support of life and His giving of food and blessings.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention even delicate tastes and appetites?
questions.answer: To show how carefully and kindly provision is given.

questions.question: What natural events are named as signs that point people to divine rule?
questions.answer: Seasonal change and the alternation of day and night.

questions.question: What should these signs lead people to accept about God?
questions.answer: That He is truly divine and deserves obedience.

questions.question: What moral pattern in history or life does the passage point to as proof of justice?
questions.answer: The support of virtue and the destruction of evil.

questions.question: Which kinds of people are used as examples of those brought down?
questions.answer: The unjust and the dishonest.

questions.question: What kind of human being must exist beside such a Lord, according to the passage?
questions.answer: A servant especially loved by Him and deeply devoted to Him.

questions.question: What job does this servant have regarding the universe’s hidden meaning?
questions.answer: He solves its mystery and explains its purpose.

questions.question: How dependent is this servant on God in carrying out his mission?
questions.answer: He relies on God for aid and success.

questions.question: Who is directly named as this servant?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What do the nine truths cause the traveler to conclude about the Prophet’s status among human beings?
questions.answer: That he is the greatest glory for mankind.

questions.question: What title does the traveler think fits the Prophet because of that status?
questions.answer: The pride of the world and the honor of the children of Adam.

questions.question: What success of the Qur’an is pointed to as evidence of the Prophet’s world importance?
questions.answer: Its powerful rule and spread over half the world.

questions.question: What inner qualities of the Prophet support that same conclusion?
questions.answer: His personal excellence and high moral virtues.

questions.question: When speaking about the Creator, whose words does the passage treat as the most weighty?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s words.

questions.question: What was the foundation and life-goal of the Prophet’s message?
questions.answer: Bearing witness to God’s existence, unity, names, and attributes.

questions.question: What made that message strong and convincing?
questions.answer: Hundreds of open miracles and thousands of basic truths in his religion.

questions.question: What heavenly image is used for the Prophet as a proof of the Creator?
questions.answer: A sun shining in the universe.

questions.question: What affectionate name does the passage use for him in relation to Allah?
questions.answer: The Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: What three broad groups are said to sign their agreement to his witness?
questions.answer: His family, his Companions, and the scholars of his community.

questions.question: What is notable about the first group’s spiritual level?
questions.answer: They include saints and people of deep spiritual vision.

questions.question: What example of certainty is given from Imam Ali?
questions.answer: His certainty was so complete that even uncovering what is hidden would not increase it.

questions.question: What example of spiritual vision is given from Abd al-Qadir al-Gilani?
questions.answer: He is described as seeing unseen heavenly realities while still on earth.

questions.question: What difficult starting conditions faced the Companions?
questions.answer: They lived among an uneducated people with little social or political development and no scripture.

questions.question: How quickly did the Companions rise after accepting the message?
questions.answer: In a very short time.

questions.question: What did they become after that rise?
questions.answer: Just rulers and guides over highly developed peoples and lands.

questions.question: How is the third group described in terms of knowledge?
questions.answer: They are careful, deep scholars who appear in every age and excel in many sciences.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s witness stronger than a private opinion?
questions.answer: Because it is backed by united, certain, and wide-reaching testimony.

questions.question: What does the final sentence about demons emphasize?
questions.answer: That the truth of this witness is impossible to defeat.

questions.question: In the passage, what is the purpose of the beautiful and wise things in creation?
questions.answer: They show the perfection of the Creator’s skill.

questions.question: What relationship does the Creator want people to have with Him through these created things?
questions.answer: He wants them to know Him and love Him.

questions.question: What human reactions are meant to come from the many favors He gives?
questions.answer: Thankfulness and praise.

questions.question: How should people respond to the way He sustains life and provides what creatures need?
questions.answer: By worshipping Him with gratitude.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way provision is given?
questions.answer: It is given with care, even in ways that match very fine tastes and needs.

questions.question: Which repeated changes in the world are named as signs of His rule and greatness?
questions.answer: The passing of seasons and the alternation between night and day.

questions.question: What should those signs lead people to do inwardly and outwardly?
questions.answer: Believe in Him and live in humble obedience.

questions.question: How does the passage present the link between justice and morality?
questions.answer: It says justice appears in protecting what is good and crushing what is evil.

questions.question: Which two sinful types are singled out as being overthrown?
questions.answer: The oppressor and the liar.

questions.question: What kind of servant does the passage say would certainly stand beside such a Lord?
questions.answer: A servant loved most by Him and completely loyal to Him.

questions.question: What does this servant do with the riddle of creation?
questions.answer: He uncovers and explains it.

questions.question: How does the servant carry out his mission in relation to God?
questions.answer: He acts for God’s sake and depends on Him for help and success.

questions.question: Who is named as this chosen servant?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What judgment does the traveler make after considering the nine truths?
questions.answer: He judges that the Prophet is the highest honor of humanity and the world.

questions.question: What spread of the Qur’an is mentioned to support this view?
questions.answer: Its commanding influence reached half the world.

questions.question: What personal qualities of the Prophet are mentioned beside the Qur’an’s influence?
questions.answer: His many excellences and lofty virtues.

questions.question: What does the traveler call the most important speech about the Creator?
questions.answer: The speech spoken by the Prophet.

questions.question: What was the basic aim behind the Prophet’s whole life and invitation?
questions.answer: To testify to and announce God’s existence, oneness, attributes, and names.

questions.question: What two major sources of proof support this mission in the passage?
questions.answer: His open miracles and the foundational truths of Islam.

questions.question: What simile is used to describe the Prophet as evidence for the Creator?
questions.answer: He is like the sun in the universe.

questions.question: What title is used to show that he is deeply beloved by Allah?
questions.answer: The Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: How many forms of faultless agreement support his testimony?
questions.answer: Three forms.

questions.question: What is the first form of agreement?
questions.answer: The united affirmation of the Prophet’s family and the great saints among them.

questions.question: Why is this first form especially strong?
questions.answer: Because it comes from people known for spiritual insight and certainty.

questions.question: What is the second form of agreement?
questions.answer: The confirmation given by the Companions.

questions.question: What does their willingness to sacrifice prove?
questions.answer: It proves the strength and sincerity of their faith.

questions.question: From what kind of background did the Companions rise?
questions.answer: From a simple, largely uneducated environment with weak social and political development.

questions.question: What did they become after embracing the message?
questions.answer: They became just rulers and respected leaders over advanced societies.

questions.question: What is the third form of agreement?
questions.answer: The unanimous confirmation of profound scholars in every age.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying the Prophet’s testimony is general and universal?
questions.answer: It means his witness is supported across groups, generations, and fields of knowledge.

questions.question: What does the statement about demons teach about the strength of this testimony?
questions.answer: It teaches that no opposing force can break it.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Creator intends people to notice in the things He has made?
questions.answer: The excellence of His wisdom and craftsmanship.

questions.question: What two personal responses toward the Creator are meant to grow from seeing creation?
questions.answer: Knowing Him and loving Him.

questions.question: How are people encouraged to offer praise and thanks in the passage?
questions.answer: By receiving countless blessings that are pleasing and valuable.

questions.question: What kind of worship is called for when people notice how life is fed and protected?
questions.answer: Worship filled with gratitude and appreciation.

questions.question: What detail about food and provision shows the Creator’s care in the passage?
questions.answer: He provides in ways that satisfy even very subtle tastes and needs.

questions.question: Which changes in time are pointed to as signs of divine authority?
questions.answer: Night and day, along with the seasons.

questions.question: What should recognizing these signs lead human beings to believe?
questions.answer: That God is truly the only divine ruler.

questions.question: After belief, what behaviors should appear in people?
questions.answer: Submission, humility, and obedience.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way justice works in the world?
questions.answer: It lifts up goodness and brings down evil.

questions.question: Which wrongdoers are named as examples of those punished?
questions.answer: Tyrants and liars.

questions.question: Why does the passage say there must be a special servant of God?
questions.answer: Because the divine purposes in creation require someone to explain them and call people to them.

questions.question: What does that servant do with the hidden meaning of the universe?
questions.answer: He unlocks it and makes it understood.

questions.question: How does this servant seek to complete his mission?
questions.answer: By acting for God and asking Him for support and success.

questions.question: Who is identified as this servant?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What do the nine truths convince the traveler to say about the Prophet?
questions.answer: That he is the great honor of humanity and of the world.

questions.question: What makes the title “pride of the world” suitable in the traveler’s view?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s unmatched influence, message, and noble character.

questions.question: What worldly evidence from the Qur’an is used to support that title?
questions.answer: Its powerful reach and victory over half the world.

questions.question: What personal evidence from the Prophet himself is added to that?
questions.answer: His many perfections and high virtues.

questions.question: According to the passage, whose statement about the Creator matters most?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s statement.

questions.question: What was the central message behind all the Prophet’s calling and effort?
questions.answer: Proving and proclaiming God’s existence, unity, names, and attributes.

questions.question: What gave this message clear strength?
questions.answer: His many undeniable miracles and the many core truths in his religion.

questions.question: What picture from nature is used for the Prophet as proof of God?
questions.answer: He is described like a sun shining in the cosmos.

questions.question: What loving title from Allah’s side is given to him?
questions.answer: The Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: What three united witnesses support his testimony?
questions.answer: His family, his Companions, and the scholars of the ummah.

questions.question: What stands out about the family members and saints in the first witness group?
questions.answer: They are known for deep certainty and spiritual vision.

questions.question: What stands out about the Companions in the second witness group?
questions.answer: They showed powerful faith through sacrifice and rapid transformation.

questions.question: What poor conditions did the Companions start from?
questions.answer: They began in an unlettered and undeveloped setting without scripture.

questions.question: What high position did they reach later?
questions.answer: They became guides and fair rulers over advanced peoples and lands.

questions.question: What stands out about the scholars in the third witness group?
questions.answer: In every age, many of them rise with deep knowledge in different sciences.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s witness called not merely individual?
questions.answer: Because many trustworthy groups confirm it together.

questions.question: What is the force of the passage’s statement about all demons joining together?
questions.answer: Even the strongest combined opposition could not defeat this proof.

questions.question: Who arrives at this final conclusion in the passage?
questions.answer: The traveler.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Creator wants to show through the universe’s skillful design?
questions.answer: The perfection of His ability and art.

questions.question: What does He want people to feel toward Him after seeing the many beautiful created things?
questions.answer: Recognition and love.

questions.question: What are the many gifts in life supposed to bring out from people?
questions.answer: Praise and thankfulness.

questions.question: How should people respond to the Creator’s care for life and His generous provision?
questions.answer: They should worship Him with grateful hearts.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention satisfying even the finest appetites?
questions.answer: To show how detailed and gentle His care is.

questions.question: What repeating changes are named as signs of His Divinity?
questions.answer: The shift of the seasons and the alternation of day and night.

questions.question: What four responses should these signs produce in people?
questions.answer: Belief, submission, humility, and obedience.

questions.question: How is divine justice described in moral terms?
questions.answer: It guards the good and destroys evil.

questions.question: Which kinds of sinners are especially mentioned as being struck down?
questions.answer: Oppressors and liars.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of human servant must be with such a Lord?
questions.answer: A most beloved creature and a most devoted servant.

questions.question: What does this servant accomplish regarding the secret of the universe?
questions.answer: He discovers it and explains it to others.

questions.question: What does the passage say about where this servant gets help in his mission?
questions.answer: He asks God for help and is given it.

questions.question: Who is named as this servant in the passage?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What do the nine truths prove to the traveler about the Prophet’s standing?
questions.answer: That he is humanity’s greatest glory and the world’s greatest honor.

questions.question: What makes that high praise deserved, according to the traveler?
questions.answer: The power of the Qur’an together with the Prophet’s own noble qualities.

questions.question: What major historical success of the Qur’an is mentioned?
questions.answer: It gained authority over half the world.

questions.question: What does the passage say is the most important thing spoken about the Creator?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s teaching about Him.

questions.question: What was the basic goal of the Prophet’s mission from beginning to end?
questions.answer: To testify to and announce God’s existence, oneness, attributes, and names.

questions.question: What kind of proofs supported this mission?
questions.answer: Many obvious miracles and many lofty truths within his religion.

questions.question: How is the Prophet described as evidence in the universe?
questions.answer: As the brightest proof, like a sun.

questions.question: What title shows his beloved status with Allah?
questions.answer: The Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: How many great united confirmations are listed after that?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: Who belongs to the first confirmation?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family and great saints among them.

questions.question: What quality gives this first group special strength as witnesses?
questions.answer: Their deep spiritual insight and certainty.

questions.question: Who belongs to the second confirmation?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s Companions.

questions.question: What proves the sincerity of the Companions’ faith?
questions.answer: They gave up life, wealth, and family ties for the truth.

questions.question: What was unusual about the setting in which the Companions first lived?
questions.answer: It was largely uneducated and lacked developed social and political life.

questions.question: What surprising result came from that beginning?
questions.answer: They quickly became just rulers and leaders over the most advanced peoples.

questions.question: Who belongs to the third confirmation?
questions.answer: Careful and profound scholars who appear in every age.

questions.question: What does the passage say about these scholars’ work?
questions.answer: They advance in many branches of knowledge and serve in different fields.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s testimony described as broad and firm?
questions.answer: Because it is confirmed by united groups across history, not by one person alone.

questions.question: What does the final image of all demons joining together teach?
questions.answer: It teaches that this testimony is too strong to be defeated.
